verificationMethod: Combined regular-season appearances above the team season game limit prove at least one shared game. The default upper bound is 82, with NBA-confirmed limits of 66 in 2011–12 and 72 in 2020–21. This verifies positive connections. Transaction-only non-overlap remains a review candidate until corroborated.
